$ deploy --help
Usage: deploy <command> [options]

Deploy the service.

Commands:
  plan      Print the changes of a deployment.
  apply     Apply the changes of a deployment.
  rollback  Roll back to an earlier release.
  registry  Count the images of the registry.

Options:
      --flag-debug  Print the value and the source of each option before the command runs.  env DEPLOY_FLAG_DEBUG
  -h, --help        Show the help.
  -v, --verbose     Print each step.                                                        env DEPLOY_VERBOSE, key verbose
[exit 0]

$ deploy plan --env prod
plan: 2 changes
[exit 0]

$ deploy -v apply -e prod -y
deploy: run apply
apply: target prod in eu-west-1
apply: 2 changes applied
[exit 0]

$ deploy apply -e prod -y --verbose
deploy: run apply
apply: target prod in eu-west-1
apply: 2 changes applied
[exit 0]

$ deploy apply -e prod
deploy: main: apply changes prod only with --yes
[exit 1]

$ deploy rollback -e dev --region us-east-1 41
rollback: release 41 restored
[exit 0]

$ deploy plan
deploy: plan: missing --env
[exit 2]

$ deploy plan --env staging
deploy: plan: invalid --env "staging" from flag --env: want dev or prod
[exit 2]

$ deploy aply -e dev
deploy: unknown command "aply" (did you mean apply?)
[exit 2]

$ deploy rollback --help
Usage: deploy rollback [options] RELEASE

Roll back to an earlier release.

Arguments:
      RELEASE  Release to roll back to.

Options:
  -e, --env dev|prod   Environment to act on.      required, env DEPLOY_ROLLBACK_ENV, key rollback.env
      --region string  Region of the environment.  default "eu-west-1", env DEPLOY_ROLLBACK_REGION, key rollback.region

Global options:
      --flag-debug  Print the value and the source of each option before the command runs.  env DEPLOY_FLAG_DEBUG
  -h, --help        Show the help.
  -v, --verbose     Print each step.                                                        env DEPLOY_VERBOSE, key verbose
[exit 0]

$ deploy plan -e dev >/dev/full
deploy: main: write the result of plan: clitest: no space left on device
[exit 1]

$ deploy registry
registry: 4 images in registry.example.com
[exit 0]

$ deploy -v registry push app:v2
deploy: run registry push
registry: sign in as deploy@registry.example.com
push: app:v2 as deploy@registry.example.com
registry: sign out
[exit 0]

$ deploy registry --url registry.internal prune --user ci --keep 2
prune: 2 images kept in registry.internal
[exit 0]

$ DEPLOY_REGISTRY_USER=ci deploy registry push app:v3
push: app:v3 as ci@registry.example.com
[exit 0]

$ deploy registry pusj app:v2
deploy: registry: unknown command "pusj" (did you mean push?)
[exit 2]

$ deploy registry push
deploy: registry push: missing argument IMAGE
[exit 2]

$ deploy registry --keep 2 prune
deploy: registry: unknown flag --keep
[exit 2]

$ deploy registry push --help
Usage: deploy registry push [options] IMAGE

Push an image to the registry.

Arguments:
      IMAGE  Image to push.

Global options:
      --flag-debug   Print the value and the source of each option before the command runs.  env DEPLOY_FLAG_DEBUG
  -h, --help         Show the help.
      --url string   URL of the registry.                                                    default "registry.example.com", env DEPLOY_REGISTRY_URL, key registry.url
      --user string  User of the registry.                                                   default "deploy", env DEPLOY_REGISTRY_USER, key registry.user
  -v, --verbose      Print each step.                                                        env DEPLOY_VERBOSE, key verbose
[exit 0]
